product: KeyLoad development preview. Not production ready.
concept: Orleans owns all clustering and activation scaling. The API reaches one grain per connected client, logical database/partition grains, storage owners and bounded result aggregation. Shared volumes require one open owner per physical partition without copies; isolated volumes use typed Orleans calls between owners. Shared-volume ownership and distributed partition-query execution are not yet qualified.

qualification.performance: No published claim without authenticated GitHub Benchmarks evidence.
qualification.powerLossDurability: Not proven; process-kill tests do not prove it.
qualification.sharedVolumeStorage: open: lazy single-owner lifetime and actual filesystem locking/flush behavior are not implemented and qualified
qualification.distributedPartitionQueries: open: current full-copy routing is not partition fan-out proof

evidence: Qualification evidence lives only in GitHub Actions runs and their original artifacts for the exact delivered source.
